articles.title: Photos from Jane and Mojo Jones
articles.summary: This document features a collection of astronomical travel photos by Jane and Mojo Jones, showcasing landmarks like the Leviathan Telescope and the Royal Greenwich Observatory, as well as a visit with Sir Patrick Moore. It also announces a holiday party on December 2nd, inviting attendees to bring food/drink contributions (no alcohol) and participate in a 'white elephant' gift exchange with an astronomical theme.

articles.title: The Shallow Sky
articles.summary: This article covers December 2006 astronomical observations, including a recent Mercury transit, upcoming Venus transit in 2012, and the visibility of planets like Saturn, Mercury, Jupiter, and Mars. It also features a biographical sketch of Annie Jump Cannon, an influential astronomer known for her work in stellar classification at Harvard Observatory, highlighting her background and the role of women "computers" in early astronomy.

articles.title: Observing across the Atlantic September-October, 2006
articles.summary: This article details a two-week astronomical journey in September-October 2006 across the UK and Ireland by Jane Houston Jones. The trip included visits to Sir Patrick Moore's private observatories, the ancient site of Stonehenge, the historic Leviathan telescope at Birr Castle and the Whirlpool Star Party where the author spoke, and the Royal Observatory Greenwich. It highlights encounters with prominent figures, historical instruments, and the shared passion for astronomy across time and geography.

articles.title: The Planet in the Machine
articles.summary: This article explores the immense complexity of Earth's weather and climate systems, likening it to a 'butterfly effect' caused by numerous interdependent variables and human activities. It introduces Earth system science, a field dedicated to building and refining mathematical models that use data from NASA's Earth-observing satellites to understand and predict climate changes and severe weather patterns. The ultimate goal is to create more accurate long-term climate predictions and short-term weather warnings to help mitigate future challenges.

articles.title: Solar System Stats for December 2006
articles.summary: This article presents detailed astronomical data for the Solar System's major planets and the Sun for December 2006, including their right ascension, declination, distances, magnitudes, and apparent sizes. It also provides a biography of Annie Jump Cannon, highlighting her groundbreaking work in developing the stellar spectral classification system and her contributions to the Henry Draper Catalogue at Harvard Observatory.

articles.title: SJAA loaner scope status
articles.summary: This article provides an updated status of the San Jose Astronomical Association's (SJAA) loaner telescope program for its members. It lists various telescopes and binoculars currently available for immediate loan, those recently loaned out, and those with extended loan periods. SJAA members can contact Mike Koop to borrow available equipment, with no waiting list currently in effect.
